I'm Dr. Agent, and I see you're experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever following antibiotic treatment for sinusitis. Have you noticed any changes in your urine, such as color, frequency, or the presence of blood?

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis
REQUEST TEST: CBC (Complete Blood Count)

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis: Leukocyturia Present; Bacterial Culture Negative; Cytospin (Hansel's): 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm. CBC: NORMAL READINGS (Not provided in available data).

speaker: Doctor
text:
The presence of binucleated eosinophilic cells in your urine, combined with your fever and flank pain shortly after antibiotic treatment, strongly suggests Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN). Did you develop a rash or experience itching anywhere on your body in the last few weeks?

REQUEST TEST: Renal_Function_Panel
REQUEST IMAGES: Renal_Ultrasound

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Renal_Function_Panel: Urea Elevated, Creatinine Elevated; Renal_Ultrasound: NORMAL READINGS.
